summary: Keep golang.org/x/net at a govulncheck-clean release, and keep the go directive at the repo .go-version floor without a toolchain line that selects a newer Go.
reason: The generated module failed govulncheck on golang.org/x/net (fixed in v0.60.0). A later toolchain go1.27.2 pin is still affected by GO-2026-6809 and makes Go 1.26.10 CI download that toolchain. A toolchain line equal to the go directive is redundant: go mod tidy deletes it and go build refuses to run until it is gone.
